posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
I figure that our shared love of superheros and games means that there have to be some Overwatch players on the forum. Right?

I'll admit that I'm not much of gamer, I got sucked into Overwatch through Blizzard's amazing animated shorts that featured the background lore of the characters. 

I've been playing for a couple of months now and would love to group up with other Sentinels fans. I play on Xbox under the name "ThatLever" if you want to find me.

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
Lucio is my favorite support character, he's lots of fun.

My main character is the tank hero Orisia. She's a newer character who was added early this year, a robot centaur who can place static shield walls.

I play a bunch of different things, but my faves are the tanks: Orisia, Reinhardt, and Winston (because who doesn't love a super-intelligent gorilla in a battlesuit?)

posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
For anyone who hasn't seen them, the Overwatch animated shorts and the game's cinematic trailer can be found at: https://playoverwatch.com/en-us/media/

They're surprisingly fun and really build up a lot of background lore for a superhero shoot 'em up.  It triggers the same thing that the color text on the SotM cards does for me.  Sentinels is a fun game by itself, but it's the lore behind the game and the relationships of the characters that makes it come alive.

posts.name: The Mariner
posts.cooked:
I’ve been called out before while playing with friends on TTS.  Something about calling that one Fanatic card that deals damage equal to her max-curent HP her “ultimate.”  Then (because we were playing with Cauldron) making a High Noon joke when I kept giving extra powers to 1929 Tango (whose power deals 3 damage at the start of her next turn, for those not aware- the guy playing her was spreading them out against Dreamer so he was going to kill like 3 projections).

AU where Lucio is Virtuoso of the Void.

EDIT: Btw my battletag is CapnMunch #1487, and it’s a lot easier to aim with Expatriette than it is with Soldier.
